title: Preservation Long Island
summary: Preservation Long Island worked with Indigenous artists and guest curators to present Indigenous History & Art at Good Little Water Place in 2020. The online exhibition brought contemporary Native art into conversation with Long Island land, water, wildlife, history, and community.
address_label: 161 West Main Street, Cold Spring Harbor, NY 11724
listing_image_alt: Painting by Shinnecock artist David Bunn Martine, on view at Preservation Long Island as part of Indigenous History & Art at Good Little Water Place (2020).
why_this_matters: References: Preservation Long Island, "Virtual Exhibition: Indigenous History & Art at Good Little Water Place," July 31, 2020, preservationlongisland.org; Indigenous History & Art at Good Little Water Place, About, indigenoushistoryandart.omeka.net.
introduction_content: The 2020 exhibition centered work by contemporary Indigenous artists and interpretation developed with Native guest curators. Preservation Long Island's Cold Spring Harbor headquarters represents the organization behind the project, while the exhibition itself remains available online.
history_content: Indigenous History & Art at Good Little Water Place was published by Preservation Long Island in 2020. The exhibition highlights contemporary Indigenous artists and interpretation connected to Long Island Native history, land, wildlife, and water.
preservation_content: The online archive keeps the exhibition accessible and documents the artists, curatorial work, and historical materials that shaped it.
